summary_en: Self-tender offer completed 13 May – 9 June 2026 (20 business days). 20.7M shares acquired at ¥2,325/share (¥48.1B total). Settlement 1 July 2026. Daiwa Securities as intermediary. Authorized by 12 May 2026 board resolution under Companies Act §156.
title_en: Notice of Results of Public Tender Offer for Own Shares
translation_en_brief: KDDI announced completion of a self-tender offer for own shares, initiated by board resolution on 12 May 2026 and executed 13 May – 9 June 2026 (20 business days). The company acquired 20.7 million shares at ¥2,325 per share, totalling ¥48.1 billion. This represents 4.2% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury). Settlement will commence 1 July 2026 via Daiwa Securities as the tender agent. The offer was conducted pursuant to Companies Act §156 (as read into §165(3)) and the company's articles. The company confirmed that any further acquisitions after completion of the tender will be conducted as open-market purchases as previously disclosed on 12 May 2026.
